messages:
elaine: Quick sync — planning to enable console.hidden-settings beta for a limited audience tomorrow AM. Need confirmation on canary scope + rollback guardrails. Flag key I'm proposing: `console.ui.hiddenSettings.v1`. Target: 1% orgs + `segment:internal-beta`. Anyone object?

josh: sounds fine. a couple quick asks: what metrics should we watch and what's our kill-switch behavior? also will PR include the client-side guard (hidden toggle + consent check)?

elaine: good Q. primary metrics: `console.feature_usage.hiddenSettings` (counts), `beta.ui.errors` (rate), and 95p latency for console load. If errors > 1% or crash-rate spikes 0.5pp above baseline for 5m we kill. Kill-switch flag name: `console.hiddenSettings.kill_now`.

tara: please add a tiny runbook (2 bullets) for oncall: how to detect, how to flip kill switch, and who to page. I'll drop the runbook into the product playbooks repo.

sam: canary timeframe? I'd prefer 48h initial watch window, slow ramp if signal clean. Also need comms for support+success — will loop them in after we confirm scope.

josh: I'll open the PR for the server toggle + client gate and add the kill-switch wiring. PR will include the flag metadata YAML and a small smoke test. snippet for the flag payload I'm planning to add:

```
{
  "flag_key": "console.ui.hiddenSettings.v1",
  "targets": ["segment:internal-beta"],
  "percentage_rollout": 1,
  "kill_switch": "console.hiddenSettings.kill_now",
  "metadata": {"owner": "product/elaine", "runbook": "link to doc"}
}
```

josh: pinging @tara for runbook link in PR. also can someone add the dashboard panels (errors, usage, latency) to the console feature dashboard?

featureflag-bot: Scheduled flag rollout: `console.ui.hiddenSettings.v1` -> start=2026-04-02T16:00:00Z (canary), ramp=manual. Watchers: elaine, josh, tara.

elaine: thanks — that time is fine. I'll notify support and eng-oncall.

tara: added a short runbook draft here: https://go.redwood/runbooks/hidden-settings-beta — includes kill procedure and escalation list.

sam: +1. For ramping plan: 1% -> 5% after 48h if signals clear -> broad after 7d. Agree with kill criteria.

josh: PR opened: https://git.redwood/console/PR/4321 — includes unit smoke, flag YAML, client gate. Requesting review from @elaine and @tara.

elaine: reviewing now. I'll approve once runbook link is in PR and dashboards are linked. Once approved, I'll flip the flag at 09:00 PT tomorrow and ping #eng-oncall.

featureflag-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-02T08:45:00-07:00 to start rollout.

josh: will be on hand for the first 2h after flip. tagging @sam for comms thread.

elaine: summary: PR -> approve, dashboards + runbook linked, flip 09:00 PT, 48h watch, kill if errors/latency spikes, ramp plan 1%->5%->broad. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: will handle support comms and post-mortem checklist if anything odd shows up.
